claim: Cuchara is at Lepelstraat 3, 3920 Lommel and partners with Taxi Flament (+32 475 86 53 10); the restaurant explicitly recommends Corbiehotel, B&B 't Wilgenhuys and B&B Ars Vivendi to guests.
quote: Lepelstraat 3, 3920 Lommel ... Taxi Flament: +32 (0) 475 86 53 10 ... Corbiehotel ... B&B 't Wilgenhuys ... B&B Ars Vivendi

claim: Cuchara holds two Michelin stars in the 2026 Belgium guide; Jan Tournier opened it in his grandparents' Lommel house in 2009, got his first star in 2014 and second in 2019.
quote: Two Stars: Excellent cooking ... In 2009, Jan revisited his roots in Lommel and opened Cuchara in his grandparents' house, and he received his first Michelin star five years later, and in 2019 he was awarded a second.

claim: B&B Ars Vivendi occupies an authentic 1904 engineer's villa at Werkplaatsen 47, 3920 Lommel, run by Ann and Guido since 2014; three renovated en-suite rooms, garden under century-old beeches and chestnuts.
quote: an authentic engineer's villa, dating from 1904 ... Werkplaatsen 47, 3920 Lommel ... three comfortable and stylishly furnished rooms

claim: B&B Ars Vivendi is ranked #1 specialty lodging in Lommel with a 5/5 Travelers' Choice rating; reviewers cite the owners' art collection and the feeling that the stay is 'won't be an ordinary weekend away'.
quote: #1 of 1 special B&B in Lommel ... 5.0/5 ... Lovingly run by Ann and Guido, their home is stunningly beautiful with it's interesting collections of object d'art.

claim: B&B 't Wilgenhuys is set on the edge of the Lommelse Sahara in a wooded plot, mixing 'vintage, Scandinavian, urban and classical elements' at Jacob Smitsdreef 2, 3920 Lommel.
quote: a lively mix of vintage, Scandinavian, urban and classical elements ... Jacob Smitsdreef 2, 3920 Lommel

claim: 't Wilgenhuys is rated 9.6 by recent Booking.com guests; 4 rooms (3 ground-floor doubles, one larger upstairs suite with balcony sleeping up to four), 2 km from Lommel center, cycling junction 25 m away.
quote: Rated 9.6 by recent guests ... located in a wooded environment next to the Lommelse Sahara with a cycling route network just 25 meters away. Lommel's city center with its bistros and cafes is only 2 km away.

claim: Eikenhoef opened in summer 2023 as a 'luxury boutique hotel' surrounded by coniferous forest, run hands-on by its young owners; positioned between cycling junctions 264 and 265.
quote: summer 2023 ... exclusive, with beautiful rooms and unparalleled hospitality ... between cycling junction points 264 and 265

claim: Eikenhoef is at Knapenhoef 42, 3920 Lommel, with check-in from 15:00 and breakfast 07:00–10:00 weekdays / 08:00–10:00 weekends; bike storage with charging is on site.
quote: Knapenhoef 42, 3920 Lommel - België ... Check-in from 3:00 PM; checkout before 11:00 AM

claim: Eikenhoef scores 9.4/10 on Booking.com across 275 verified reviews; recurring praise: spacious modern rooms, breakfast, owner hospitality; one reviewer flagged the 'Luxury Boutique' label as overstated.
quote: rated 9.4 out of 10 by Booking.com guests based on 275 verified reviews ... beautiful interior and spacious rooms ... 'Luxury Boutique' doesn't align with the simple, small rooms

claim: Eikenhoef offers a small inventory of rooms (sources vary between 4 and 7 listed rooms) including doubles, family rooms and quadruples with private bathrooms, air-conditioning and balconies.
quote: family rooms with private bathrooms, air-conditioning, and balconies ... double, family, and quadruple types

claim: Corbie Hotel Lommel averages 8.0/10 across 549 reviews — central, walkable to Cuchara, but rooms are described as small, dated and occasionally noisy; positioned as a practical, business-style stay.
quote: previous guests have rated their stay at the hotel an average of 8.0 out of 10 stars in 549 reviews ... rooms are a bit cramped ... rooms are starting to show their age

claim: B&B Hoeven Het Gehucht is a 1957 hobby-and-children's farm at Kortestraat 1, 3900 Pelt (Lindelhoeven), run by Rudy and Tania Mertens-Van Leuven, on the edge of Bosland national park.
quote: Kortestraat 1, B-3900 (Over) Pelt (Lindelhoeven) ... a hobby- and children's farm with vegetable and fruit cultivation ... owned and adapted since 2006 by Rudy and Tania Mertens-Van Leuven

claim: Natuur-like Glamping Bosland in Lindelhoeven (Pelt) offers wood-platform bell tents next to a pond inside the Bosland national park; ~6 km from the German military cemetery in Lommel.
quote: located in Bosland in Hechtel-Eksel ... wooden platform overlooking a pond ... 6 km from cultural attractions such as the German military cemetery in Lommel

claim: Natuur-like Glamping Bosland scores 8.6/10 on Booking.com; bell tents accommodate up to three, compost toilet, no running water, gas-fire cooking — true camping with a wooden platform.
quote: rated 8.6 by recent guests ... compost toilet for an eco-friendly experience ... no running water and no shower in the tent

claim: B&B Huis Spaas in Sint-Huibrechts-Lille (Pelt) is a recently renovated historic building rated 9.3/10 for couples on Booking.com; large rooms, garden, bar.
quote: recently renovated bed and breakfast within a historic building ... located in Sint Huibrechts Lille, in the municipality of Pelt ... 9.3 for two-person trips

claim: The Werkplaatsen neighborhood where Ars Vivendi sits is a 1904–1914 garden-city of ~75 listed workers' and managers' dwellings built around the former zinc factory; a designated heritage zone.
quote: Starting in 1904 ... a garden city was built south of the factory with housing for both management and workers ... 75 dwellings, and some of these are listed on the Architectural Heritage List

claim: Lommel taxi base fare is €4.90 with €1.90/km; a 5 km hop is ~€13, a 10 km trip ~€24 — meaning any of the candidate stays sits comfortably under €25 one-way to Cuchara.
quote: starting price of a taxi in Lommel is 4.9 EUR, with each KM priced at 1.9 EUR ... 5 km trip would cost 13 EUR, a 10 km trip would be 24 EUR

claim: Visit Lommel lists Eikenhoef among Lommel's official boutique hotel offerings — third-party validation that it sits in the boutique-hotel bucket rather than chain/business.
